props.name: density
props.description: Particles per 10,000 square pixels. 3 is about 150 in a wide hero.

props.name: speed
props.description: Pixels a particle travels per frame at 60fps.

props.name: scale
props.description: How zoomed-in the noise is. Smaller values give broader, calmer currents.

props.name: fade
props.description: How quickly trails fade, from 0 (never) to 1 (no trail at all).

props.name: lineWidth
props.description: Stroke width of each trail in pixels.

props.name: colors
props.description: Colours the particles are drawn in — tokens such as `var(--color-accent)`, or any CSS colour.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seed for the noise, so the same field comes back on every visit.

props.name: label
props.description: Describe the image for assistive tech. Without it the canvas is decorative and hidden.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged last, so it wins. Give the component a size here.
